name: ollamaforge
description: Local AI coding agent powered by Ollama — memory, code graph, autonomous agent, MCP support. 100% local, no telemetry, no internet required.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npx vsce package
scripts.test:harness: npm run compile && mocha --require dist/test/vscode-mock.js --timeout 30000 dist/test/unit/agentHarness.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && nyc mocha dist/test/unit/**/*.test.js

commands.title: Ollama: Ingest Markdown Files into Memory
Ollama: Scan Project Docs into Memory
Ollama: Export Agent Log for Review

ollamaForge.contextWindow.markdownDescription: Override the context window size (in tokens) for the selected model. Set to `0` (default) to auto-detect from Ollama. Use this when Ollama reports the architecture maximum instead of the actual loaded `num_ctx` — e.g. set to `65536` for `gemma4:26b-65k`.

ollamaForge.model.description: Default model to use when the extension starts. Overridable per session via the model selector in the sidebar.

ollamaForge.temperature.markdownDescription: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = balanced, 2 = creative). Only sent to Ollama when it differs from the default.

ollamaForge.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt override. Leave empty to use the built-in coding assistant prompt.

ollamaForge.autoIncludeFile.description: Auto-attach the full active file content to every message sent.

ollamaForge.autoIncludeSelection.description: Auto-attach selected code from the active editor when a selection exists.

ollamaForge.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace files to include when the agent auto-loads context. Higher values increase token usage.

ollamaForge.injectGitDiff.markdownDescription: When enabled, injects a concise `git diff` of your uncommitted changes into every message. Helps the agent understand what you're currently working on. Only works in git repositories.

ollamaForge.autoRunTests.description: When enabled, automatically run the corresponding test file after a successful edit. Results are shown in the chat. Only runs if a matching test file is found.

ollamaForge.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect to. Each server provides additional tools for the agent. Example: `[{"name": "filesystem", "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path/to/workspace"]}]`

ollamaForge.memory.enabled.description: Enable multi-tiered memory system for persistent project knowledge.

ollamaForge.memory.qdrantUrl.markdownDescription: Qdrant server URL for semantic memory search, e.g. `http://192.168.1.100:6333`. Leave empty to auto-derive from the Ollama server URL with port 6333.

ollamaForge.memory.embeddingModel.description: Ollama embedding model for semantic search (e.g., nomic-embed-text, mxbai-embed-large).

ollamaForge.memory.embeddingUrl.description: Ollama URL for embeddings. Leave empty to use main Ollama URL.

ollamaForge.memory.autoSave.markdownDescription: Automatically save important information to memory as the AI discovers it. Saves are filtered through garbage patterns and semantic dedup to prevent noise.

ollamaForge.autoCompactContext.markdownDescription: Automatically compact conversation history when context reaches 99% of model's limit. You'll be alerted at 70% usage and reminded until 99%, then auto-compact will trigger if enabled.

ollamaForge.enableThinking.markdownDescription: Enable chain-of-thought reasoning for models that support it (e.g. qwen3, deepseek-r1). The model will reason internally before responding — slower but more accurate for complex tasks like code verification, debugging, and doc cross-checking. Requires a compatible Ollama model.

ollamaForge.search.url.markdownDescription:
URL of your [SearXNG](https://searxng.github.io/searxng/) instance, e.g. `http://192.168.1.100:8888`. Leave empty to disable web search (agent stays fully offline).

SearXNG is a free, self-hosted meta-search engine — no API key required. Run it alongside Ollama on the same host:
```
docker run -d --name searxng -p 8888:8080 \
  -e SEARXNG_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32) \
  searxng/searxng:latest
```
The agent appends `/search?q={query}&format=json` automatically. SearXNG must have the `json` output format enabled (on by default in the Docker image).

ollamaForge.search.resultsLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of search results returned per `web_search` call (1–20, default 5). Higher values give the agent more context but use more tokens.

ollamaForge.comfyui.url.markdownDescription: Base URL of your ComfyUI server, e.g. `http://192.168.1.100:8188`. Leave empty to disable image generation. ComfyUI must be running with SDXL Base (`sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors`) loaded. Generated images are saved to `.ollamaforge/tasks/<task_id>/images/` in the workspace.

ollamaForge.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show "✨ Explain" and "📝 Document" lenses above functions and classes. **Note:** May add visual clutter in large files.

ollamaForge.inlineCompletions.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable inline code completions (similar to GitHub Copilot). Suggestions appear automatically as you type. **Note:** This feature uses your local Ollama model and may slow down typing on slower machines.

ollamaForge.inlineCompletions.triggerMod.markdownDescription: How to trigger inline completions: `automatic` (as you type) or `manual` (only when you press the shortcut).

ollamaForge.maxTurnsPerSession.markdownDescription: Maximum number of agent tool-call turns per session. `0` (default) uses built-in limits per task type (sweep=50, merge=60, plan=50, normal=40, small-model=8). Set to a lower value (e.g. `24`) to cap resource usage for large models.

ollamaForge.routing.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable automatic multi-model routing. When enabled, the agent uses a smaller/faster model for read-only exploration turns (shell_read, memory_search) and reserves the main model for write/edit turns. Configure the fast model with `routing.fastModel`.

ollamaForge.routing.fastModel.markdownDescription: Model name to use for read-only exploration turns when `routing.enabled` is true (e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`). Leave empty to use the main model for all turns.

ollamaForge.routing.criticModel.markdownDescription: Model name to use for the automated critic review pass after edits when `routing.enabled` is true (e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:7b`). Leave empty to use the main model.

ollamaForge.dreamModel.markdownDescription: Model to use for the dream cycle (self-improvement analysis). Leave empty to use the main model. Prefer a model with a large context window (≥32k) since the dream prompt includes feedback logs and session history.

ollamaForge.contextFile.autoUpdateDays.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh `AGENTS.md` in the background when it is older than this many days (checked on workspace open). Set to `0` to disable auto-refresh. The `/context` slash command always refreshes on demand regardless of this setting.

ollamaForge.keepAlive.markdownDescription: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded in GPU memory between requests. Use Ollama duration syntax: `10m` (10 minutes), `1h` (1 hour), `0` (unload immediately after each request), `-1` (keep loaded forever). A longer value reduces cold-start latency for consecutive agent turns. Default: `10m`.

ollamaForge.stack.sshHost.markdownDescription: SSH host for stack health checks, e.g. `user@192.168.1.100`. Leave empty to disable. Requires existing SSH key auth — no passwords stored.

ollamaForge.stack.composePath.markdownDescription: Path to `docker-compose.yml` on the remote host, used for service restarts and upgrades of Qdrant and SearXNG.

ollamaForge.stack.healthCheckOnDream.markdownDescription: Run a stack health check as part of the nightly dream cycle. Issues are surfaced in the dream cycle notification.
